from.place: 09MR proof, Mayer–Vietoris paragraph: the localization maps form a map of long exact sequences and the five-lemma gives P(U union V)

title: Mayer–Vietoris gluing for the localization comparison
statement: Let $Y$ be a quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], let $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal L)$, and let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. For an open subscheme $W\subseteq Y$ and $n\ge0$ let $\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n}$ be the tensor power of [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and for $n<0$ put $\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n}=(\mathcal L|_W^{\vee})^{\otimes(-n)}$ with $\mathcal L^{\vee}$ the dual of [def-sc-invertible-module]. For $p\ge0$ set $H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)=\bigoplus_{n\in\mathbb Z}H^p(W,\mathcal F|_W\otimes\mathcal L|_W^{\otimes n})$ [pqf-def-cohomology], a graded module over the graded ring $\Gamma_*(W,\mathcal L)=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Gamma(W,\mathcal L^{\otimes n})$ via tensor product and multiplication of sections, and let $H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}$ be the degree-zero part of its localization at the homogeneous element $s|_W$ of degree $1$, i.e. the module of fractions $\xi/s^n$ with $n\ge0$ and $\xi$ homogeneous of degree $n$. Let $W_s=W\cap Y_s$, with $Y_s$ the open subscheme where $s$ does not vanish [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and let $c^p_W:H^p_*(W,\mathcal L,\mathcal F)_{(s)}\to H^p(W_s,\mathcal F|_{W_s})$ be the canonical map sending $\xi/s^n$ to $s^{-n}\xi$ (restrict $\xi$ to $W_s$, where $s^n$ is a trivializing section of $\mathcal L^{\otimes n}$, and divide by it). Let $U\subseteq Y$ be a quasi-compact open and $V\subseteq Y$ an affine open. If $c^p_U$, $c^p_V$ and $c^p_{U\cap V}$ are isomorphisms for every $p\ge0$, then $c^p_{U\cup V}$ is an isomorphism for every $p\ge0$.
